question: Should `tools.fs.workspaceOnly: false` permit content-verified host-local APK attachments as part of the safe document and archive policy?
rationale: Tests can settle classification mechanics, but only maintainers can accept adding an installable package type to the host-local send boundary.

options.title: Allow verified APKs
options.body: Permit APK sends only when archive contents provide Android package evidence, while keeping ordinary JARs and filename-only claims blocked.

options.title: Keep APKs blocked
options.body: Retain the current allowlist and pause or close this PR if installable packages should remain outside host-local document sends.

recommendation.title: Allow verified APKs
recommendation.body: Permit APK sends only when archive contents provide Android package evidence, while keeping ordinary JARs and filename-only claims blocked.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and PR discussion most strongly connect this person to the current host-read policy, tests, and documentation.
